Plugin Development Overview

Description

The Macle MiniProgram Tools plugin (plugin for short, which can be downloaded from Downloading) is a Mini Program development plugin provided for developers to develop Mini Programs in a familiar development environment (VS Code). The plugin provides functions such as encoding and debugging.

Functions

This section describes how to use plugins in different phases of the Mini Program development process.

Development Preparations

Download and install the plugin in Downloading to the local PC for development.

Coding Efficiency

In the actual development process, the following tools can greatly improve the development efficiency:

  • Simulator: simulates the running of the Mini Programs locally to facilitate quick preview and preliminary debugging.
  • Code completion: provides MAML autocomplete, API autocomplete, and syntax prompt.

Debugging Mode

To locate bugs or performance bottlenecks, select the following debugging mode:

  • Simulator debugging: provides the simulator for preliminarily debugging basic functions and styles.
